meta.scope: Syria Batch 7 — Residual densification: northeast oil/gas (Hasakah), and Gulf external investment re-engagement under extremely constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Northeast oil and gas production framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from energy and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of residual oil and gas production in the northeast (Hasakah and related fields). Fields continued to operate under SDF influence during the conflict; current capacity is a fraction of pre-war peaks but remains the principal domestic hydrocarbon resource. Reintegration and redevelopment are central to fiscal and energy recovery.
candidates.notes: Core residual hydrocarbon densification under fragmented control history.

candidates.title: Gulf external investment and re-engagement framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from investment and diplomatic monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of post-transition Gulf economic re-engagement. Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE and others have announced multi-billion-dollar investment packages, port concessions, power projects and aviation deals. These flows are a leading indicator of external reconstruction financing under sanctions relief.

candidates.description: Meta-node binding northeast oil/gas framing and Gulf external investment re-engagement into a coherent residual energy and external-financing layer under extremely constrained conditions.
